title: Safe vs Unsafe Rotation
shortDefinition: Safe rotation occurs when Knee Line is free and heel is hidden; unsafe rotation occurs when Knee Line is trapped and heel is exposed.
whyItMatters: Leg lock injuries usually come from turning the wrong direction in an entanglement, knowing when to turn and when to stop is technical safety.
deepExplanation: Safety assessment in order: (1) Is the heel exposed? (2) Is the Knee Line trapped? (3) Is the secondary leg controlled? If all 3 signals are present, do not rotate, tap or free yourself first. If heel hidden and knee free, you can rotate safely.
beginnerView: Do not rotate hard when the heel is exposed and the knee is trapped.
advancedView: Use rotation sensing to bait: let them feel Knee Line is trapped then change direction.
